name: Zuari Industries Ltd
title: Zuari Industries Ltd - 500780 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone EBITDA fell to INR31.3 cr from INR36.9 cr and PAT was a loss of INR9.5 cr; profit depends on Dubai repatriation (INR142 cr received of ~INR900 cr guided) and a sugar price rally that is not yet in the numbers.

summary.headline: Zuari Q1 FY27 standalone loss widened to INR9.5 crore PAT on sugar margin squeeze; Dubai St. Regis repatriation of INR142.58 crore received so far against INR900 crore FY27 target.
summary.overview: Standalone total income rose 26% YoY to INR283.9 crore on higher sugar volumes and realisations, but EBITDA fell to INR31.3 crore from INR36.9 crore and PAT swung to a loss of INR9.5 crore from a loss of INR3.9 crore. Management attributed margin pressure to an 8% rise in UP cane SAP (INR370 to INR400 per quintal). Consolidated PAT was a marginal INR0.05 crore, supported by associate income, mainly Zuari Agro Chemicals. Management reiterated the INR900 crore Dubai repatriation target for FY27 and said that sugar prices are at record highs, which it expects to support the next quarters.

segments.name: Sugar
segments.commentary: Sales of 4.7 lakh quintal vs 3.6 lakh quintal (+29% YoY) on higher domestic quota; realisation INR4,116/quintal vs INR4,036. Segment revenue INR236.8 crore (+34%) but segment profit fell to INR8.4 crore from INR12.3 crore. Recovery 11.7%; mill ran only six days in April 2026.

segments.name: Ethanol
segments.commentary: Production up 1% to 10,138 KL and sales up 5% to 10,248 KL; realisation INR60.70/litre, described as static. Molasses-route recovery was lower, and outsourced molasses was not economical, so no extra purchases were made.

segments.name: Power
segments.commentary: Power sales of 62.8 lakh units vs 7.7 lakh units in Q1 FY26; R&M is in progress ahead of the crushing season.

segments.name: Real estate (Zuari Infraworld)
segments.commentary: Total income INR33.9 crore (+25% YoY), EBITDA INR24.6 crore (vs INR21.7 crore), PBT loss INR0.7 crore (vs loss INR1.5 crore). St. Regis Dubai reached 100% completion; handovers have started.

segments.name: Engineering (Simon India)
segments.commentary: Executed about INR30 crore of projects in the quarter; about INR70 crore of orders under execution. Management cited deferred capex in West Asia crisis.

segments.name: Financial services and broking
segments.commentary: Zuari Finserv total income INR4.1 crore vs INR5.9 crore. Zuari Insurance Broker brokerage income INR3 crore vs INR3.8 crore; EBITDA INR2.2 crore vs INR3.2 crore; gross return premium INR20.8 crore vs INR33.3 crore.

guidance_outlook: Dubai St. Regis profit repatriation: INR900 crore expected in FY27; INR142.58 crore (AED55 million) received in Q1 and July–August, with about INR750-758 crore balance expected in FY27.
Zuari Agro Chemicals loan of about INR258 crore expected to be repaid in the current quarter (Q2 FY27).
Management expects INR100-110 crore interest saving in FY28 from repaying about INR1,100 crore of debt at 9.73% average cost, per the analyst's calculation accepted on the call.
Sugar prices rose about 10% in the past month to record highs; UP prices INR4,860-4,920/quintal. Management expects festival demand to support realisations; exports are not currently allowed.
Management expects the next OMC ethanol tender in October 2026 and plans to participate; it expects the government may revise ethanol prices in the near term.
Furniture division decision expected by the end of FY27 (revival or other action).
capex_capacity: Sugar facility operating at 100% capacity utilisation; R&M under way for the 2026-27 crushing season.

Ethanol capex on hold because of overcapacity: last tender sought 1,050 crore litres against INR1,800 crore of offers. Management aims at 1,000 KLPD in the long term but will invest only once demand clarity emerges.
Zuari Envien Bioenergy (ethanol JV) stabilised plant operations this quarter and has orders until October 2026.

Gangothri Tribhuja (Hyderabad) saleable area 2.8 million sq ft; sales office complete, marketing under way. DM agreement for 14.8-acre plotted development in Bengaluru with RERA approval; cycle time about 15-18 months.

Zuari Infraworld DM order book about INR6,000 crore (per Alok Banerjee) vs GDV of about INR4,900 crore (per Athar Shahab); aspiration INR10,000 crore GDV. Launches in Hyderabad and Bengaluru expected next month.
demand_pricing: Indian sugar prices up 10% in the past month to record highs; global raw sugar about 16.6 cents/lb, near 1-year highs. Management attributes this to lower FY26 closing stocks (4.3 MMT vs 5.3 MMT).
Ethanol realisation static at INR60.70/litre; management says this weighs on margins.
Cane SAP in UP up 8% (INR370 to INR400/quintal), the main driver of margin compression.
Simon India orders slowed by West Asia-related capex deferrals across sectors.
Zuari Finserv and insurance broking volumes declined as the market weakened (gross return premium down about 38% YoY).

qa_highlights.question: How much Dubai St. Regis repatriation is expected in the current quarter and the next, and are there buyer challenges?
qa_highlights.answer: AED55 million (INR142.58 crore) received in the quarter; INR900 crore guided for FY27 with the balance on track; management said no buyer back-outs or discount demands so far.

qa_highlights.question: How much FY28 interest saving from repaying about INR1,100 crore of debt?
qa_highlights.answer: Jatin Jain cited 9.73% average cost of borrowing; the analyst's INR100-110 crore saving estimate was accepted on the call.

qa_highlights.question: Rationale and timing of buying Zuari International shares for INR150 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Transaction to be done in one or more tranches funded by an ICD approval; aim is to consolidate listed and unlisted group holdings into Zuari Industries and let the holding entities repay external debt.

qa_highlights.question: Will the Zuari Agro INR95 crore ICD get a six-month extension, and when will the INR258 crore be repaid?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not confirm any extension; said the entire INR258 crore outstanding is expected to be repaid in the current quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Will ethanol capacity expand, and are OMC tenders expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Next OMC tender expected in October 2026 and the company will participate; capex on hold due to overcapacity (1,050 crore litres tendered vs 1,800 crore litres offered), with investment only after demand clarity.

qa_highlights.question: Why did standalone EBITDA fall despite revenue growth, and why did sugar segment profit drop?
qa_highlights.answer: UP cane SAP rose 8% (INR370 to INR400 per quintal); extra one lakh quintal of sugar sales from higher quota added about INR45 crore revenue, but segment profit fell to INR8.4 crore from INR12.3 crore on cane cost.

qa_highlights.question: Sustainability of earnings of sugar, power and ethanol over next 12-18 months?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects the segments to recover in the next season, cites high sugar prices and a healthy UP cane crop, and expects a fairly decent quarters ahead.

qa_highlights.question: Concern over Texmaco share purchase at INR190 and shareholder value?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the earlier Zuari International transaction was only an enabling resolution with no actual deal; future transactions will be at market price.

qa_highlights.question: Dubai repatriation, buyer payments and segment asset timing at Zuari Infraworld?
qa_highlights.answer: Alok Banerjee said about 40-45% of customer collections remain; payment plan is 50-50 and demand notes were raised post completion certificate. Real estate segment assets of INR770 crore as on 30 June 2026, mainly INR400 crore Dubai receivables, expected to convert in one to two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Zuari Infra DM pipeline and GDV path to INR10,000 crore?
qa_highlights.answer: Order book about INR6,000 crore per Alok Banerjee; GDV of projects in hand about INR4,900 crore per Athar Shahab, roughly halfway to the INR10,000 crore aspiration; Hyderabad and Bengaluru launches next month; plotted project cycle time 15-18 months.

risks_watch: Dubai repatriation: INR142.58 crore received against INR900 crore FY27 target; about INR750-758 crore balance must come in the remaining FY27 period, with buyer payments (about 40-45% of customer collections) still outstanding.

Ethanol overcapacity: last OMC tender 1,050 crore litres against 1,800 crore litres offered; ethanol realisation static at INR60.70/litre; October 2026 tender outcome and any government price revision are key.
Sugar margin squeeze from 8% UP cane SAP increase; mill ran only six days in Q1; recovery 11.7%; sugar prices at record highs and exports not allowed.

Related-party exposure: Zuari International/Zuari Management share purchase (about INR150 crore via ICD), Zuari Agro INR258 crore repayment due this quarter with a reported INR95 crore ICD extension request not confirmed on the call.
Simon India engineering orders (about INR70 crore under execution) and Zuari Finserv/broking volumes weakening; West Asia capex deferrals.
Goa land monetisation put on hold after new law and higher circle rates; furniture division decision due by end of FY27. Unresolved UP ethanol export fee exposure (INR507 lakh) with no provision.

No, we are not facing any challenges whatsoever so far.
Athar Shahab: Absolutely. We are expecting the next round of tenders to come sometime in October and the company will be certainly participating in that round, OMCs round.

As a policy, we do not comment on rumors.
summary.management_tone: Confident on sugar prices, Dubai repatriation and real estate, but evasive on the Zuari International/Texmaco share transactions, the Zuari Agro ICD extension and the ethanol policy, where management declined to comment on rumours or quantify outcomes.
